removed_share.hiring.label: Hiring posts later removed
removed_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts from the first 7 days that were deleted or killed before we fetched the thread. It depends on how long after the window we fetched (years for old months, about a day for new ones), so it is for the methodology note only and not comparable across months.

removed_share.seeking.label: Job seeker posts later removed
removed_share.seeking.description: Share of “Who wants to be hired?” posts from the first 7 days that were deleted or killed before we fetched the thread. It depends on how long after the window we fetched, so it is for the methodology note only and not comparable across months.

posts.hiring.label: Hiring posts
posts.hiring.description: Top-level posts in the first 7 days of the monthly Hacker News “Who is hiring?” thread, including ones later deleted. One post often covers several roles, so this counts posts, not jobs.

posts.seeking.label: People looking for work
posts.seeking.description: Top-level posts in the first 7 days of the monthly “Who wants to be hired?” thread, including ones later deleted.

seekers_per_post.hiring.label: Job seekers per hiring post
seekers_per_post.hiring.description: Posts from people who want work divided by posts from companies hiring, in the same month. Both counts include posts later deleted.

seekers_per_post_us.hiring.label: US job seekers per hiring post open to US workers
seekers_per_post_us.hiring.description: Job seekers per hiring post, counting only seekers whose Location line is in the US and hiring posts whose first line names a US place or offers remote work US workers can take (no region stated, or the US, North America, the Americas, worldwide or US time zones). Both counts include posts later deleted. Deleted posts, seekers whose location we can't place, and hiring posts that name no place and don't mention remote work are assumed to split the same way as the rest. Shown only when at least 50 seekers have a known location.

replies_per_post.hiring.label: Replies per job post
replies_per_post.hiring.description: Average number of direct replies a job post got in its first 7 days.

salary_disclosed_share.hiring.label: Posts that show pay
salary_disclosed_share.hiring.description: Share of job posts that state a yearly salary figure or range, in any currency. Hourly rates, equity and funding amounts don’t count. Posts from 2011–12 are about half as long as later ones, so early shares run low.

salary_min_median_usd.hiring.label: Typical bottom of the pay range
salary_min_median_usd.hiring.description: Median across posts of each post’s typical low end of pay (the median of its ranges’ lows), among posts that give yearly pay in US dollars.

salary_max_median_usd.hiring.label: Typical top of the pay range
salary_max_median_usd.hiring.description: Median across posts of each post’s typical high end of pay (the median of its ranges’ highs), among posts that give yearly pay in US dollars.

remote_token_share.hiring.label: Posts that say remote
remote_token_share.hiring.description: Share of job posts whose first line mentions remote work (and doesn’t rule it out). Starts in July 2015, when the REMOTE/ONSITE header convention took hold.

onsite_token_share.hiring.label: Posts that say onsite
onsite_token_share.hiring.description: Share of job posts whose first line says the job is onsite. Starts in July 2015, when the REMOTE/ONSITE header convention took hold.

visa_share.hiring.label: Posts that offer visa help
visa_share.hiring.description: Share of job posts that offer visa sponsorship or transfers. Posts that say they can’t sponsor are not counted. Posts from 2011–12 are about half as long as later ones, so early shares run low.

new_company_share.hiring.label: New or returning after two years
new_company_share.hiring.description: Share of companies posting that had not posted in any of the previous 24 months’ threads. Starts in April 2013, the first month with a full 24 months of history behind it.

returning_company_share.hiring.label: Back from last month
returning_company_share.hiring.description: Share of companies posting that also posted the month before.

ai_native_share.hiring.label: Posts describing an AI product
ai_native_share.hiring.description: Expected share of job posts from companies whose product is built on AI or machine learning, as judged by a language model reading each post.

new_grad_share.hiring.label: Open to new grads
new_grad_share.hiring.description: Expected share of job posts open to new graduates or junior engineers, as judged by a language model reading each post.

seeker_mood.seeking.label: Job seeker mood
seeker_mood.seeking.description: Average mood of “Who wants to be hired?” posts on a 0 (discouraged) to 4 (upbeat) scale, as judged by a language model reading each post.

seeker_strained_share.seeking.label: Job seekers under strain
seeker_strained_share.seeking.description: Expected share of “Who wants to be hired?” posts that sound discouraged or strained: a long search, a layoff, urgency or money worries, as judged by a language model.

seeker_us_share.seeking.label: Job seekers in the US
seeker_us_share.seeking.description: Share of “Who wants to be hired?” posts whose Location line is in the US, among posts whose Location line names a place we recognize.

eng_leadership_share.hiring.label: Hiring engineering leads
eng_leadership_share.hiring.description: Expected share of job posts hiring engineering managers or leads, as judged by a language model reading each post.

interns_token_share.hiring.label: Posts that mention interns
interns_token_share.hiring.description: Share of job posts that mention interns or internships anywhere in the text. Posts from 2011–12 are about half as long as later ones, so early shares run low.

work_mode.label: How companies want people to work

funding_stage.label: How far along hiring companies are

region.label: Where hiring posts are, by region

seeker_region.label: Where job seekers are, by region

seniority_ai_native.label: Which levels AI-native companies are hiring

seniority_not_ai_native.label: Which levels other companies are hiring

industry_known.label: What hiring companies do, among posts that say

indeed_software_postings.US.label: Indeed US software development job postings
indeed_software_postings.US.credit: Indeed Hiring Lab, job postings tracker
indeed_software_postings.US.description: Seasonally adjusted Software Development postings on Indeed, 7-day trailing average, indexed to February 1, 2020 = 100. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.

indeed_software_postings.GB.label: Indeed UK software development job postings
indeed_software_postings.GB.credit: Indeed Hiring Lab, job postings tracker
indeed_software_postings.GB.description: Seasonally adjusted Software Development postings on Indeed, 7-day trailing average, indexed to February 1, 2020 = 100. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.

indeed_software_remote_share.US.label: Indeed US software postings offering remote or hybrid work
indeed_software_remote_share.US.description: Share of Indeed software development postings that mention remote or hybrid work, 7-day trailing average. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.

indeed_software_remote_share.GB.label: Indeed UK software postings offering remote or hybrid work
indeed_software_remote_share.GB.description: Share of Indeed software development postings that mention remote or hybrid work, 7-day trailing average. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.

indeed_software_pay_transparency.US.label: Indeed US software postings that state pay
indeed_software_pay_transparency.US.credit: Indeed Hiring Lab, pay transparency tracker
indeed_software_pay_transparency.US.description: Share of Indeed software development postings with explicit pay, by month posted. Indeed publishes it for the US only. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.

jolts_openings_information.US.label: Job openings, information sector
jolts_openings_information.US.credit: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, JOLTS; vintages via ALFRED
jolts_openings_information.US.description: Job openings, information sector, thousands, not seasonally adjusted. The newest month BLS had published by the as-of date, usually two months before the HN month. Each month shows the value as first published by that month's as-of date; later revisions are not applied.
